name: UserMorph
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
UserMorph empowers Administrators and developers to instantly “morph” into any user account on their site with a single click. No more logging out and back in with different credentials.

Traditional user switching requires you to navigate to the Users screen, find the user, and click a link. UserMorph changes the game with its Smart Search Bar integrated directly into your WordPress Admin Bar. Just hover, type a name or email, and switch instantly.

Why choose UserMorph?

  • Lightning Fast Workflow: Switch from anywhere on your site without leaving the page you are on.
  • Search and Switch: Use the AJAX-powered search bar in the toolbar to find users by name, username, or email.
  • Developer Friendly: Perfect for testing user roles, custom capabilities, and personalized dashboard views.
  • Support Hero: Debug customer issues in real-time by seeing exactly what they see.

Core Features

  • Instant Admin Bar Switcher: A searchable dropdown in the top bar for rapid account swapping.
  • Seamless Switch Back: A dedicated “Switch Back” button returns you to your original Admin session instantly.
  • Quick User Links: Adds “Switch To” links directly to the Users list for traditional navigation.
  • Switch Off Mode: Logout temporarily to view your site as a visitor while keeping a secure link to jump back into your admin account.
  • Enterprise Security: Uses WordPress’s native authentication and nonces. Fully compatible with SSL and caching plugins.

Other Plugins by VerseSofts

If you like UserMorph, check out our other powerful tools for WordPress and WooCommerce:

  • Advanced Order Status For WooCommerce: Take control of your order fulfillment with custom statuses and automated triggers.
  • HealthBeam: Monitor your site’s health and performance in real-time.
  • Store Restriction for WooCommerce: Sophisticated access control and product visibility for your store.
  • Price & Cart Hider – WooCommerce: Hide prices and checkout buttons based on user roles or login status.
  • Multiple Cart Fee – WooCommerce: Add flexible extra fees to the WooCommerce cart based on specific conditions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the usermorph folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. You will immediately see the “UserMorph” menu in your Admin Bar.
sections.faq:
Who can use UserMorph?

By default, only users with the edit_users capability (Administrators and Super Admins) are allowed to switch accounts.

Is my site secure while using this?

Absolutely. UserMorph respects all WordPress security protocols. It doesn’t store passwords and uses secure, encrypted cookies to manage the “switch back” session.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! It’s perfect for testing WooCommerce customer accounts, checking order statuses from the customer’s perspective, or verifying “My Account” page customizations.

Can I switch back to my account easily?

Yes, a prominent “Switch Back to [Admin]” link appears in the admin bar as soon as you switch to another user.
